results.title: Someone Else's Capital, Tested on Inverset Platform
results.description: Most trading platform reviews are written from the same premise one person, one account, one risk appetite. This Inverset review starts from a different position. The account under consideration belongs, in practice, to two people: a parent making the trades

results.title: Micron workers demand 15% of operating profit as AI boom lifts chip earnings, point to Samsung, SK Hynix
results.description: Micron Technology faces labor unrest as employees reject a proposed bonus of 68 months' salary, threatening strikes. Workers demand a one-time bonus equivalent to 83 months' salary and quarterly bonus distributions amidst rising profits driven by AI technology demand.
